title: every live doc_lint finding is baselined, so the gate can never go red

first_order.what_broke: The founder opened the docs bundle and hit a document describing an architecture that has since changed. scripts/doc_lint.py already detects this class. On main it reports 45 findings and the baseline contains all 45, so the ratchet is green while every single finding is live.
first_order.receipt: On main (worktree at 2073c274, 0 commits behind origin/main) `scripts/doc_lint.py` reports 45 problems; docs/doc_lint_baseline.json holds 45 entries across 14 files, so `--check` is green and `doc_lint.py` plain is red. Worst files: OPS_CONSOLE_PROGRAM.md 8, SUBSCRIPTION_PROGRAM.md 7, ENGINE_RELIABILITY_PROGRAM.md 6, HARDCODED_MODEL_AUDIT_TICKET.md 5, PAYMENT_P0_GEMINI_BRIEF.md 5. CORRECTION: this record first said 184 findings behind a 27-entry baseline. That was measured in the shared checkout, which was 38 commits behind origin/main. Same defect, smaller number, and the number itself was an instance of the class in `read-docs-on-origin-main-not-the-shared-checkout`.

cause_chain: docs/doc_lint_baseline.json contains every finding doc_lint can currently produce, and check_ratchet only fails on a regression against that baseline, so no live finding fails anything.
The gate was installed with the existing rot grandfathered in, and nothing was scheduled to burn the baseline down, so grandfathered became permanent.

Nothing measures whether a doc's CLAIMS still match the live estate — only whether the paths it names exist. docs/ENGINE_AUDIT_2026-08-10.md passed doc_lint on 2026-08-18 while six of its concrete statements about the engine were false, because a wrong line number and a retired provider roster are not missing paths.
CLASS: a ratchet with no burn-down schedule is a warning fence, and a warning fence is not a fence.

sibling_list: tests/unit/swallow_ratchet_baseline.json — 23 grandfathered tier-1 swallows across 16 files, plus 5 waivers. Same shape: existing findings suppressed, no burn-down date.
second_order.note: SWEPT 2026-08-18. Two candidates rejected on inspection and named so nobody re-sweeps them: tests/fixtures/gen_quality_baseline.json is a reference fixture, not a suppression list; register_baseline.py is a report-only script. register_baseline.py:18 does hardcode an absolute store path, which is a sibling of INC-2026-08-18-store-resolver, not of this one.

third_order.note: The mechanism is a burn-down date on the baseline file itself: doc_lint --check fails when today is past the date, so a suppression cannot outlive its own deadline. Not written yet.

grade.signature: doc_lint findings suppressed by the baseline
